title: GeneLab Proteomics TMT Data Sheet Schema
description: Schema for TMT data sheet CSV files (one row per mzML file, fraction-centric).

run.description: Unique identifier for each raw file (MS run). Used for manifest file paths.

fraction.description: LC fraction identifier within a plex (MSstatsTMT Fraction). Use 1 when samples were not fractionated.

TechRepMixture.description: Mixture technical replicate identifier for a plex. Use 1 when the mixture was run once. Sets manifest Bioreplicate and MSstatsTMT TechRepMixture.

Has Tech Reps.description: Indicates whether this mzML row is a technical replicate that should be collapsed with other rows sharing the same plex, TechRepMixture, and fraction. Set to True for technical replicates that should be collapsed, False for distinct runs. When not provided, treated as False.

Source Name.description: Optional biological subject identifier for metadata.

data_file.description: URL or path to the mass spectrometry data file in mzML format
